name: Investigate the Camp: the hunters' camp trigger credits the player the client reports in it (#10544)
contract: Quest 201 Investigate the Camp is completed by areatrigger_involvedrelation (98, 201). The client fires trigger 98 from its AreaTrigger.dbc: a 30 yard sphere at (-11619.7, -54.924, 11.17). The world areatrigger row sat 15 yards away at (-11634.8, -54.0697, 13.4439), so a player who entered the client's sphere from the east was more than 30 yards from the server's centre, HandleAreaTriggerOpcode rejected the packet and the client never resent it.

Expected: with 201 in progress, a player 25 yards east of the client's centre (40 yards from the old world centre) who sends CMSG_AREATRIGGER 98 completes the quest. A player 45 yards east of the client's centre, outside the client's sphere, is still rejected.

steps.label: The far player takes it too
SETUP: the quest is in progress
SETUP: the far player's quest is in progress
